# README.md

Source: https://github.com/matt765/tailcast/blob/main/README.md

<div align="center">

<div id="user-content-toc">
  <ul align="center" style="list-style: none;">
    <summary><h1>Tailcast</h1></summary>
  </ul>
</div>

**Dark-themed website template built with Astro 6 & Tailwind CSS, designed for a fictional startup.**<br>
Responsive, fast, and ready to customize.

[Live Demo](https://tailcast.vercel.app) · [Getting Started](#quickstart) · [Changelog](https://github.com/matt765/Tailcast/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)


</div>

## Tech stack

Astro 6, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS 4, ESLint, Prettier

## Features

- **8 pages** - Home, About, Services, Blog, Article, Careers, Contact, 404
- **SEO optimization** - Sitemap, Open Graph, canonical URLs, meta descriptions
- **Accessible** - Semantic HTML, ARIA attributes, keyboard navigation
- **View Transitions** - Smooth page navigation with Astro Client Router, no full-page reloads
- **Responsive** - Mobile-first design that adapts to any screen size
- **Code quality** - ESLint, Prettier and CI pipeline pre-configured with Astro and Tailwind plugins

## Quickstart

```bash
git clone https://github.com/matt765/Tailcast.git
cd Tailcast
npm install
npm run dev
```

Navigate to [http://localhost:4321](http://localhost:4321) to see the site.

You can also deploy on Vercel with one click:

[<img src="https://vercel.com/button" alt="Deploy with Vercel" height="32">](https://vercel.com/new/clone?repository-url=https://github.com/matt765/Tailcast)

## Project structure

```
├── public/
│   ├── favicon.svg
│   ├── og-image.png
│   └── robots.txt
├── src/
│   ├── assets/
│   │   ├── icons/          # SVG icon components
│   │   ├── images/         # Optimized with Astro Image
│   │   └── logos/          # Brand logo components
│   ├── components/         # Reusable Astro components
│   ├── content/
│   │   └── blog/           # Markdown blog posts
│   ├── data/               # Static data (positions)
│   ├── layouts/
│   │   └── Layout.astro    # Base layout with SEO meta
│   ├── pages/              # File-based routing
│   │   ├── about.astro
│   │   ├── blog/
│   │   ├── careers/
│   │   ├── contact.astro
│   │   ├── index.astro
│   │   └── 404.astro
│   └── styles/
│       ├── Theme.css       # Design tokens & utility classes
│       └── diagonals.css
├── astro.config.mjs
├── eslint.config.js
├── package.json
└── tsconfig.json
```

## Available commands

| Command           | Action                           |
| :---------------- | :------------------------------- |
| `npm run dev`     | Start development server         |
| `npm run build`   | Build for production (`./dist/`) |
| `npm run preview` | Preview production build locally |
| `npm run lint`    | Run ESLint                       |
| `npm run format`  | Format code with Prettier        |

# CONTRIBUTING.md

Source: https://github.com/matt765/tailcast/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md

Thank you for your interest in contributing to Tailcast project. I appreciate your feedback, which is invaluable in helping me improve and grow this theme.

## Reporting Issues

If you encounter any issues, have suggestions for improvements, or would like to share your thoughts, please open an issue on the GitHub Issues page or contact me directly.

## Pull Requests

For some time, I will hold off on accepting external merge requests. While I greatly appreciate your willingness to contribute code, I am currently focused on managing the project's development internally. This may change in the future.

## Sponsorship

If you would like to support the ongoing development and maintenance of this project, you can do so through the GitHub Sponsors program. To become a sponsor, you can click the "Sponsor" button on my profile.

Thank you once again for your interest and support!

~matt765
